subject: Law Enforcement Identification and Masking Ordinance
overview: The committee discussed and approved a draft ordinance regulating law enforcement identification and masking requirements before referring it to the full City Council.

items.title: Law Enforcement Identification and Masking Ordinance
items.summary: The committee approved a draft ordinance that restricts on-duty law enforcement officers from masking and requires them to display visible identification, referring the matter to the full City Council.
